Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Initial SIG submission request — Redwood Inference

Hi Michael,

Thanks for taking our call today. As part of HearthTech's vendor selection for inference infrastructure we need a completed SIG questionnaire and supporting evidence for SOC 2 / ISO controls. Attached is our RFP excerpt and the SIG request packet — can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: 

- Completed SIG spreadsheet (we prefer the standard Sternum format but our template is attached)
- Latest SOC 2 Type II report or SOC 2 summary and point-in-time attestations
- KMS/HSM key management process description and any third-party attestations
- Network segmentation diagram (high-level) and data-flow for PII/PHI ingestion

Our procurement timeline is tight: responses by 20 May would keep you on the short list. If you need an NDA or a secure upload location for sensitive artifacts, let me know.

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Vendor Manager, HearthTech

Thanks Mike / Elena — I've reviewed the packet. Summary of our approach and gaps we need to close: 

- SOC 2: We can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary (period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31) and the auditor's opinion. Full report requires an NDA; offer that to HearthTech.
- KMS/HSM: We use a customer-key option backed by AWS KMS and offer HSM-backed key escrow on Dedicated/Private deployments. Need to confirm whether HearthTech requires HSM attestation (FIPS 140-2) or KMS audit logs only.
- Network diagram: I'll draft a high-level segmentation diagram showing control plane vs. customer VPC, ingress filters, and logging hops.

Attachments: I pushed an internal control crosswalk (redwood_control_crosswalk.csv) with preliminary mapping of our standard SIG answers to HearthTech's template. Please review and add owners.

Open questions for HearthTech:
1) Do you require white-box evidence (e.g., anonymized log extracts) or is an auditor statement sufficient?
2) For ISO controls that reference data residency, can you confirm whether EU processing is required for this RFP?

Neha Kapoor
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redwood_control_crosswalk.csv
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@hearthtech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 11:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial SIG submission request — Redwood Inference

Neha — thanks, that crosswalk is helpful. A few clarifications:

- HSM vs KMS: For this engagement we prefer HSM-backed key escrow evidence or an auditor statement that keys are customer-isolated for multi-tenant hosted customers. KMS audit logs may be acceptable if you can demonstrate key separation.
- White-box evidence: We can accept redacted log extracts that demonstrate retention and access controls. Our security team will still request an auditor call for select controls.
- Data residency: Not required for initial evaluation — US region is fine. If we progress to PoC we will specify required regions.

Please include a high-level network diagram showing where PII flows from ingestion to model inference and any external partner integrations. Also: can you confirm retention windows for request/response logs (both ephemeral cache and persisted traces)?

Regards,
Elena

Elena / procurement team — attaching our package for initial review. Items included: 

- Completed HearthTech_SIG_Template.xlsx (answers completed, see control-level comments)
- redwood_soc2_summary.pdf (SOC 2 summary + auditor opinion excerpt)
- network_diagram_v1.png (high-level segmentation and data-flow; note: redacted for public sharing)
- control crosswalk (updated)

Notes:
- We redacted operational logs and PII from the diagram and sample artifacts; we can provide redacted log extracts showing retention behavior. Full unredacted artifacts and full SOC 2 report available under an NDA.
- Retention windows: request/response traces retained 30 days by default for hosted customers (configurable up to 365 days under Dedicated/Private contracts). KV cache traces are ephemeral and not persisted beyond inference session unless customer opts-in to retention.

Next steps: if HearthTech wants an auditor call, we can schedule Neha + our auditor (Aveda Audit) for the week of May 24.

Mike
